problem:
Consider the vector $x$ and the subspace $S=\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ -1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,\,x=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3 \\ -9 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the distance between $x$ and the subspace $S$ given that the set ${{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}$ is orthogonal.

activity_context.topic_title: Projecting Vectors Onto Subspaces in Euclidean Spaces (Orthogonal Bases)
